verdict.rationale: Graphite documents custom rules that let a team define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing code, plus comment exclusions. AI Review customizations are listed as a paid-plan feature. That covers the core of encoding team rules for the AI reviewer, but the docs only give it a brief mention. Missing for 10: confirmation that rules are written in natural language, AST/pattern-based rules, linking external style guides, detail on how strictly rules are enforced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I encode my team's own review guidelines — natural-language rules, AST patterns, or linked style guides — and the reviewer enforces them

citations.quote: Custom rules allow you to define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing your code.
Comment exclusions allow you to specify situations where Graphite Agent should not leave comments.
